rationale: Focus F prioritizes a controlled, opt-in pilot of a deterministic live capability, which aligns with the observed usefulness gap of needing to validate the effectiveness of such a feature before full-scale deployment. It provides a coherent deliverable with a clear success criteria and minimal risk of overcomplicating the system.
uncertainty: There is a risk of limited user feedback and potential issues with the narrow scope of the pilot, but these are mitigated by the controlled and opt-in nature of the pilot.
